title: A scorecard for the AI age
summary: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.
body: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.
summaryZh: OpenAI首席财务官Sarah Friar提出了一套针对AI时代的实用记分卡，旨在通过量化有用工作、成功任务成本、系统可靠性以及计算回报（Return on Compute）来准确衡量人工智能部署的实际经济效益。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI财务官介绍了衡量AI投资回报率的实用记分卡，涵盖有效工作、单次任务成本与计算回报。
